# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Detailed timeline of events leading up to, during, and after the accident.
3. Description of the accident scene.
4. Full identification of involved individuals (employees, witnesses, managers, emergency responders).
5. Description of the injury or damages sustained.
6. Detailed account of any immediate actions taken post-accident (first aid, emergency services, containment of hazards).
7. Identification of any hazardous materials involved, if applicable.
8. Description of the equipment involved and its status before, during, and after the accident.
9. Documentation of any machinery failures or system malfunctions, if applicable.
10. Photographs or sketches of the incident scene, before and after cleanup, if available.
11. List of personal protective equipment (PPE) used by employees involved, if any.
12. Indication of whether the incident was related to work tasks or conditions.
13. Statements from the affected workers and witnesses (take care to document separate accounts).
14
